reproduction: start-native-pi-install.ps1 reached the Guest staging/start path and then constructed its Host record with temporary_network=true.
observation: PowerShell treated bare true as a command and terminated the launcher with 'The term true is not recognized'; the VM-side detached process may already have been started, so the Host record was not written.
expected: The launcher should use the PowerShell boolean literal $true and write a durable start record after the Guest start result is known.
impact: Host-side state was not recorded even though Guest-side effects may exist; a blind retry could duplicate npm/Pi installers.
evidence: start-native-pi-install.ps1 error output from RUN_ID EPT-PI-GUEST-NPM-INSTALL-20260929-02.
minimal_change: Replace the bare boolean literal true with $true and inspect current Guest/adapter state before any retry.
rollback: Revert the one literal change; no sample was executed or modified.
verification: PowerShell parse check, exact current adapter/process/status inspection, then a new RUN_ID if the prior installer did not reach a terminal state.
unresolved_risk: The Guest installer may be running without a Host start record; current state must be harvested before another launch.
